title_en: Global Atom Topology PoC (Core-100) with Multi-Gate Robustness

abstracts_en.kdd_180w: Global Atom Topology PoC (Core-100) with Multi-Gate Robustness. We present a core-100 proof-of-concept that transforms high-complexity narrative corpora into atom-level structures and computes topological similarity beyond lexical overlap. The resulting network contains 100 nodes and 3854 gate-passed edges, with 1115 old-new cross edges and a detected phase-transition signal. Our robustness stack combines drift, negative-control, and counterfactual gates; integrated status is GO, and the mean base-minus-counterfactual gap is 0.362182. Methodologically, we atomize candidates, build pairwise gated topology, and run drift + negative-control + counterfactual checks before external reporting. Key limitations remain operational: N^2 scaling requires staged expansion and compute budgeting, and 4D mapping can accumulate synchronization noise. Historical corpora here are stress-test beds for context-filter robustness, not doctrinal proof.
